description: The phase 3 (Devices) final review (M9) saw no device markers on the console floor plans in the demo. Data on dev (2026-10-22): 13 of 19 seeded Nova Tower devices have a position (Loading Dock, Lobby Lounge, Main Entrance, Reception Kiosk, Turnstile Gallery, Parking P-1); 6 have none (Executive Floor Reader, Front Door Camera/Terminal, Meeting Room 12A Camera, Server Room Camera/Climate Sensor/Reader). Only 3 cameras have coverage. Plans exist for areas Lobby, Floor 12, Parking Level P-1. A device is drawn on the plan of its area or the nearest enclosing area with a plan (placedOnPlan, apps/admin-ui/src/fields/plan-rows.ts). To do: give every seeded device a position (and the cameras a coverage) in the plan its area resolves to (apps/backend/src/seed/devicePlan.ts), check the Floor 12 devices and that the positioned ground-floor devices resolve to the Lobby plan (areas outside the Lobby subtree resolve to no plan), and confirm the markers on the Lobby, Floor 12 and Parking plans in the console.

title: Floor plan shape editor has no keyboard input

Found in UI phase 2 task 3 review.

title: storage: org_admin can upload sensitive-kind files through hasura-storage
description: Found by apps/admin-ui tests (task 6). As org_admin (Nova Tower), POST /v1/files to the org bucket with metadata[]={name, metadata:{kind:'profile_document'}} succeeds (201) and storage.files.metadata ends up {"kind":"profile_document"}. The storage_files insert check that rejects sensitive kinds does not fire, most likely because hasura-storage 0.7.2 inserts the row without metadata (user headers) and writes metadata afterwards with the admin secret. Fix in the data layer (e.g. a BEFORE INSERT/UPDATE trigger on storage.files rejecting sensitive kinds unless uploaded by the backend, or a check on update). Repro: tests/integration/files.dev.test.ts (sensitive-kind case, currently expected to fail).
notes: The repro test in apps/admin-ui/tests/integration/files.dev.test.ts is it.skip until fixed (it would leave an undeletable file each run).

title: Uploaded face source photos (kind face_source) are never deleted
description: The console uploads enrollment photos as organization files of kind face_source and passes their ids to enroll_face / create_identity_from_photos / add_identity_photos; the backend stores its own crop (identity_photo) and keeps the original. No retention class, DSR erasure or orphan sweep covers face_source files, so original face photos of refused and accepted requests stay in storage. Options: delete the sources in the enrollment actions after processing, or add face_source to an orphan sweep / the photos retention class and to DSR erasure (source_file_id is on the crop metadata). Found in UI phase 4 task 3.
close_reason: Fixed in de769d9: stale face_source sweep in drain_file_deletions (1 h grace) + enqueue_unused_files takes a crop's source_file_id original
